edges.reason: msg.sender determines whose balance is debited in transfer (balances[msg.sender]).
msg.sender is the allowance owner written into allowed[msg.sender][spender] in approve.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance allowed[from][msg.sender] is debited in transferFrom.
msg.sender sets the allowance and is forwarded to the untrusted receiveApproval callback in approveAndCall.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferOwnership executes.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before transferAnyERC20Token executes.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, establishing the privileged account.
Constructor (via Owned) writes the owner state variable from msg.sender.
Constructor credits the entire initial supply into balances.
Constructor writes _totalSupply = 1000000000000000.
Constructor assigns symbol = 'VNS'.
Constructor assigns name = 'Venuscoins'.
Constructor assigns decimals = 8.
transferOwnership writes the pending owner into newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner and later clears it to address(0).
acceptOwnership sets owner = newOwner, completing the ownership handover.
transfer reads and writes the balances mapping for msg.sender and the recipient.
transferFrom debits balances[from] and credits balances[to].
transferFrom decrements allowed[from][msg.sender], relying on the allowance mapping.
approve writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][spender].
approveAndCall writes the allowance before making the external callback.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from the stored supply.
balanceOf returns balances[tokenOwner].
allowance returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
transfer calls safeSub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the sender balance and the allowance.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient balance.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call on an attacker-supplied contract after writing allowance.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call into an arbitrary token contract.
safeAdd computes the raw addition before the require(c >= a) overflow guard.
safeSub computes the raw subtraction guarded by require(b <= a).
safeMul computes the raw multiplication with a division-based overflow check.
safeDiv computes the raw division guarded only by require(b > 0).
